svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Harnesses
svg.desc: Twelve harnesses. Each card shows the two ends, the housings with their position count and the cut length of each branch. Lengths are estimates: cut long, route on the frame, trim, record. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.
svg.text: Twelve harnesses. Each card shows the two ends, the housings with their position count and the cut length of each branch. Lengths are estimates: cut long, route on the frame, trim, record.
Rev C | Source: 17 OCT 2026 | Print layout: 17 OCT 2026
17 x 11 in / landscape / 0.5 in margins / print at 100%. Sources and open checks: docs/wiring-atlas.md.
Sensor wires to the IMU, logic power from the PDB, one 3V3 tail down the far side to the driver board. Splice SP1 near the Pico.
All Pico I/O down the front face of the far half. Three branches: driver board, leg junction encoders, kill-chain sense.
Unswitched fused bus up to the 5 V regulator. 22 AWG.
Pololu 2813 VOUT across the PWR deck to both drivers. XT30, 20 AWG.
5 V and GND down the mid gap to the leg junction board. 22 AWG.
Pack to the inline fuse to the kill-chain board. XT30 at the board. 20 AWG.
Housings: green = JST XH 2.50 mm, red = XT30, blue = the Pololu 1x6 0.1 in housing. Grey cells are empty positions.
Cut length = route model x 1.10 + 2 x 15 mm, rounded up to 5 mm. The USB cable and the optional UART0 header are not harnesses. EL-07 has the pin of every position.
